purpose: Twists: a library Environment plus a change that matters (another planet, series or parallel, a different liquid, a heavier mass, an added factor). Each must be generated, never served from the library (V5-D01), and should reuse its base where one exists. Evaluation plan section 1.
status: DRAFT written by Claude on 2026-11-17: not yet approved by the owner
how_to_approve: Edit or keep the questions, set approved to true, then run: uv run python -m eval.v5.sets --pin. The change of hash is a declared amendment (record it in the changelog).

questions.question: How does the pressure change as a diver goes deeper in salt water compared with fresh water?
What happens to the current in a circuit if I connect two resistors in parallel instead of one?
How would Newton's cannonball behave if it were fired from a mountain on the Moon?
Hooke's law, but with two springs in series on Mars.
How does the extension of a spring depend on the load if the spring is twice as stiff?
What happens to the extension if two springs hang side by side instead of one?
How much would I weigh on Mars compared with Earth if I carry a 10 kg backpack?
How does the current change with resistance if I double the battery voltage?
What happens to the pressure on a diver in oil instead of water?
How do I find the concentration of an acid by titration if the alkali is twice as strong?
How does the weight of an astronaut change as they travel away from Earth?
What happens to a satellite's orbit if it is launched faster?
What happens to the stretch of a spring if the same weight hangs in water instead of air?
How does the current change if a bulb and a resistor are in series with the battery?
How does gravity on the Moon compare with Jupiter, and what does it do to a falling ball?
Does yeast make limewater go milky faster if I add more sugar?
Is the pressure at the bottom of a tall narrow tube different from a wide one of the same height?
What happens to the colour change in a titration if I use a different indicator?
How does the stretch of a rubber band compare with a spring when I hang masses on it?
How does the weight of the same mass change at the equator and at the poles?
